title: Sharp universal death of entanglement threshold for Pauli Hamiltonians
summary: We determine the exact universal high-temperature separability threshold for Pauli Hamiltonians of bounded degree $Δ\ge2$. If every coefficient in the Hamiltonian has magnitude at most one and each term has overlapping support with at most $Δ$ other terms, the Gibbs state is a mixture of product Pauli eigenstates whenever \[ β\le z_Δ:= \operatorname{arctanh}\left[\max_{0\le x \le 1}x\left(\frac{1-x}{1+x}\right)^{Δ-1} \right]. \] For every $β>z_Δ$, a finite commuting Hamiltonian with maximum overlap degree at most $Δ$ has an entangled Gibbs state.
